correctness.rationale: PASS: Exact prepoint kernel gives n>=2 -> -r or 2n+r and n<=-2 -> +r or 2n-r; center 0 -> ±1, ±1 -> {0, ±2}. For r=1 the unique communicating class is {0,±1}∪{±(3·2^k−1)}, and direct incoming-flux balance yields 1/5 center masses plus 1/(5·2^{k+1}) outer masses. For r>=2 closed class is the ±r(2^{k+1}−1) ladders, masses 2^{-k-2}, and center transient. Four-step P1⁴(x,0)>=1/16 and five-step P_r⁵(x,{±r}) minorization imply uniform TV geometric mixing. Exact geometric tail shells give (3/5,6/5) or (r,2r) liminf/limsup and p-moment iff p<1. Conditional one-step absolute drift equals 1 at 0, 0 at ±1, r outside; summing with geometric mixing gives 3t/5+O_x(1) for r=1 and rt+O_x(1) for r>=2, exact for exterior starts. Infinite-state statements are established by renewal/Doeblin arguments, not finite simulations.
residual_risks: Integer r>=1 and minimal threshold ℓ=1 only, not a real-parameter phase transition.
Strong total-variation convergence does not imply convergence of unbounded absolute first moment.
